about: Tasks of the ctx benchmark (docs/benchmark.md). Two tasks per folder: the resume prompt below, typed in French as when resuming work, and a specific question described here in generic terms. The exact specific prompt, the pointer files that answer each task (given to the judge), the label -> folder map, the reference answers and the redaction list live in a local, unpublished map file (run_benchmark.py --map).

folders.label: course-notebooks-A
folders.kind: course folder: two lab notebooks, a helper module, a notes file

tasks.prompt: Où on en est et que faire ensuite ? Donne 3 actions concrètes avec les fichiers concernés.

tasks.description: Which cells of the first lab notebook still hold a `# Todo` marker, in which parts, and whether the second notebook has any left.

folders.label: course-notebooks-B
folders.kind: course folder: three lab notebooks and a small module

tasks.prompt: Où on en est et que faire ensuite ? Donne 3 actions concrètes avec les fichiers concernés.

tasks.description: Which notebook is the least advanced, with the count of never-executed code cells per notebook.

folders.label: course-labs
folders.kind: course folder: three lab assignments (scripts, notebooks, subjects as PDF)

tasks.prompt: Où on en est et que faire ensuite ? Donne 3 actions concrètes avec les fichiers concernés.

tasks.description: Which lab assignment is the most recent and what it contains (exercises, Colab notebook, subject).

folders.label: course-with-project
folders.kind: course folder: lab notebooks, a graded mini-project with a report, its public code copy

tasks.prompt: Où on en est et que faire ensuite ? Donne 3 actions concrètes avec les fichiers concernés.

tasks.description: For the graded mini-project: the report files, the script that regenerates figures and tables, and where the public copy of the code is.
